scope: exploratory mechanism and coevolution study; no optimum/regret claims
selection: last update only, no test selection or tuning
initialization: fresh matched random Actor; common same-seed ERM warmup generated within this branch
fixed_training: uniform centers, frozen warmup Actor, lambda5
coev_initialization: warmup Actor/baseline/optimizer, own fixed-trained attacker; population inherits PPO; random/es have zero attacker training cost
population: uniform opponent among live Actor and latest three historical snapshots; live Actor trained on selected geometry; attacker and live Actor losses need not form one saddle objective
maddpg_moving_opponent: clear reward replay before every coevolution search because Actor and lambda change; keep network and optimizer learning; fixed-Actor phase retains replay
metric: Actor own-action wirelength in fixed [.1,.9] square
forbidden: external reference solver, optimal labels, MST, geometric bound, external pretrained weights

statistics.aggregate: paired crossed bootstrap of seeds and centers; same sampled center indices shared across resampled seeds within distribution
statistics.multiplicity: exploratory, unadjusted CIs; all comparisons retained
